author: VANSMITHLAB
title: Universal Everything
summary: A studio in Sheffield since 2004. It creates digital characters, motion and large-scale imagery, exploring how minimal forms can feel alive through gait, rhythm and response.

hero_image.alt: A worktable of walk-cycle drawings in sequence, glossy black sculptural forms and a jointed card figure, with pencils and a roll of tape.
hero_image.caption: Motion studied frame by frame and then in the hand: the moving figure as the studio's material.
